ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached figure shows nine square cells: one central cell marked with a question mark and eight cells arranged around it on a circular circumference. Lines through the center form four diameters: vertical, horizontal, and two diagonals, each containing two opposite circumference cells plus the central cell. Reasoning: Let the central cell be c. Each of the four diameters has sum 13, so adding the four diameter sums gives 4 x 13 = 52. In this total, the eight circumference cells are counted exactly once altogether, and their sum is given as 40. The central cell is counted once in each diameter, so it is counted 4 times. Therefore 52 = 40 + 4c. Thus 4c = 12 and c = 3.

method.method_draft: From the image, identify that the figure has one central cell and eight cells on the circumference, arranged so that there are four straight diameters through the center: vertical, horizontal, and two diagonals. From the text, use that each diameter has three cells summing to 13 and that the eight circumference cells sum to 40. Add the four diameter-sum equations together: the eight circumference cells are counted exactly once, while the center cell is counted four times. Thus 4·13 = 40 + 4c, so solve for the central value c = 3.

method.method_draft: From the image, group the eight circumference cells into four opposite pairs, because each pair lies with the central cell on one diameter. From the text, each diameter total is 13, so for central value c, every opposite outer pair has sum 13 − c. Since there are four such opposite pairs and together they make all eight circumference cells, their total is 4(13 − c). The text says this total is 40, so 4(13 − c) = 40, giving c = 3.

推理：设中央格子的数为 c。题目说每条直径上三个数的和是 13，所以每一对相对的圆周格子的和都是 13 - c。图中的八个圆周格子正好可以分成四对相对的格子，因此圆周上八个数的总和是 4(13 - c)。题目又说圆周上八个数的和是 40，所以 4(13 - c) = 40。解得 13 - c = 10，因此 c = 3。
